commonPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original editorial raster illustration for an Italian university course slide deck, displayed beside live text at about 430 pixels wide.
Visual direction: a polished, restrained contemporary educational illustration. Clean confident 2D contour drawing, calm flat color areas, a few large legible forms, generous negative space. Elegant simplified human figures with natural proportions, minimal facial detail and clear gestures. Geometry and diagrams are precise, not sketchy. Replace the previous dense saturated indigo/yellow poster language with quieter warm amber/yellow tones. No heavy metro rails or oversized decorative circles.
Palette: Tailwind amber-800 #973C00 for outlines and the main shapes, amber-950 #461901 for small deep details, amber-200 #FEE685 and yellow-100 #FEF9C2 for pale warm fills, a very small yellow-400 #FDC700 selection accent, white for interior paper and screen surfaces. These are the only visible colors. Warm light fills dominate; dark amber is used sparingly. No indigo, purple, blue or green.
Background: true alpha transparency outside the illustration, no white rectangular backdrop, no enclosing card, border or frame. White can appear inside objects. Leave about 8% transparent breathing room so complete subjects do not touch the image edges.
Constraints: one cohesive composition, no headings, text, letters, digits, logos or watermark. No fake lettering. No gradients, texture, photorealism, 3D, shadows, glow, generic AI brains, robots, ornamental plants or floating speech bubbles. The drawing must explain the subject at small slide size.
refinementPrompt:
Edit target: the provided warm amber illustration. Make a precise cleanup of this same illustration for placement on a pale gray academic slide.
KEEP the exact people, their gestures, the subject objects, the composition, aspect ratio, amber/brown outlines, yellow/cream palette, and the visual meaning.
REMOVE EVERY BACKGROUND PIXEL outside the drawn subjects and their deliberately bounded enclosed cream shapes. Remove the entire blurred brown, black, cream and yellow vignette, glow, halo, ambient shadow and color cloud. Remove all drop shadows, decorative spark rays and stray speckles. Outside solid illustration contours must be genuinely completely transparent, not black, not white, not a checkerboard pattern, not a faded colored backdrop.
FLATTEN all shading/gradients inside the retained illustration into clean solid, fully opaque flat colors: deep amber #973C00 and #461901 outlines, pale amber #FEE685 and cream yellow #FEF9C2 fills, a few small #FDC700 selected details, and white interior paper/screen areas. Sharp professional printed contours, no texture or sketch effects. Retained foreground fills must be fully opaque at alpha 255. Transparency belongs only outside subjects and in intentionally empty gaps; only very narrow antialiased edges may be partly transparent.
Do not add a background or enclosing frame. Do not change the scene, add objects, redesign figures, crop subjects or introduce text. Deliver a clean transparent cutout of the illustration.
